quality_gate: no quota filling; retain original image, URL, CAS and duplicate protections
repeat_review: every 3 calendar days through existing daily worker
decision_rule: No observed improvement: first diagnose publishing/distribution/data; if valid data remains flat, switch one content topic/style/format or frequency variable for next 3-day cycle, record action. Missing data is not zero; repair collection and make a reversible exploratory change without claiming proven effect.
